name: weaponsmith-class-bonus-durability
notes: Weaponsmith's ability fires from ResolveBeforeRecollectionPhaseStart (GameLogic.php ~9366), gated on WARRIOR Class Bonus, and (when exactly one WEAPON is on the field) applies automatically with no MZCHOOSE. Champion CardID-patched to Lorraine, Blademaster (WARRIOR), with exactly one WEAPON on the field (Warrior's Longsword). Both players end turn 1/2 (same pattern as arcanists-prism-recollection-wheel-draw) to reach P1's own turn 3 recollection phase. The seeded Warrior's Longsword enters with its printed 2 durability counters, so the single recollection-phase trigger leaves it at 3. (An earlier version of this note read the 3 as the trigger firing three times; the initial state shows the weapon already carries 2 counters, so it fired once.)

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] At the beginning of your recollection phase, put a durability counter on target weapon you control.
